_: Per-suite end-to-end durations, harvested from real CI runs. WHAT THIS IS: the input to the shard assignment in .github/workflows/ci.yml, so that assignment is derived from data rather than from an impression. Consumed only by check:e2e-roster's PRINTED summary. WHAT THIS IS NOT: a budget, a bar, or anything any gate asserts against. No test compares a wall-clock time to a number in this file, and none may: docs/specs/ci-sharding/feature-spec.md 1.4 forbids a wall-clock assertion anywhere in this epic, because five samples of the same job span 40-47 minutes and the slowest measured altered no test at all. These are ratios that happen to carry units. STALENESS: the run id and date below are printed beside every projection, so a reader sees the projection's age at the same time as the projection. They will drift as suites are added and that is expected; re-harvest rather than trusting them. RE-HARVEST 2026-11-13 (five shards): every web figure is a SINGLE run, not a median: the four web shard jobs of run 43447550605 (PR #1355, head f9057c4b, all four green; `run`), one step per test:e2e script, mapped by the script the step runs, as the time from the step's start to the next step's start in the job log; `job` is the longest web job of it (shard 2, 131960858067, 1,740 s). The only other candidate, PR #1357's run (head 63a84cb3), has three complete shards and one cancelled by the 30-minute timeout, so it cannot supply every suite; where both have a suite the two disagree by up to about 30 % (workspace-chrome 745 s here, 823 s there; base test:e2e 510 s, 660 s; gantt-editing 314 s, 372 s). `test:e2e:edit` is 527 s measured plus 130 s PLANNED for one more two-user pen-handoff journey about to land, an ESTIMATE, so it reads 657 s. The 2026-10-13 medians this replaces had drifted to 73 % of this measurement (3,950 s recorded against 5,392 s measured; docs/TECH_DEBT.md #590). Each shard's FIXED cost (job wall less its suite steps) was 87-105 s on the four jobs of run 43447550605 and 88-100 s on the four of PR #1357, against the 114 s median recorded on 2026-10-13; the pack adds ~97 s to every shard. A step includes its own server start, so the three production-build suites carry their `vite build` in their own figures (csp 24 s, forced-colors 6 s, splitting 17 s). The two API figures are carried over unchanged from the 2026-10-12 harvest (run 38290423490); this re-harvest read web shard jobs only. This replaces the 2026-10-13 web harvest (runs 38314679272, 38315222823 and 38317448630, median of three).
